rules.comment: player's slow Snorlax uses Curse last every turn while the toxic'd AI lead dies at turn end; no AI replacement has a Fighting move, so the damage pass runs with Curse

rules.notStageable: Looks impossible in Factory singles. After every action HandleAction_TryFinish runs HandleFaintedMonActions (battle_util.c:638-645), so a Pokemon that faints before its own move is replaced at once, and the switch-in cancels its pending action (B_ACTION_CANCEL_PARTNER, battle_script_commands.c:5268-5273); if it was the last Pokemon the battle ends first. The other mid-turn faints (Explosion user, recoil, Destiny Bond, Spikes on a Baton Pass or switch) hit a Pokemon whose action is already used or is a switch. No chain found where an attacker at 0 HP reaches attackcanceler (battle_script_commands.c:924). Not proven; the Mechanic Lab would not help (it is the turn machinery, not a missing move).

rules.comment: player Metronome x10; needs Rage (1/340) on a turn the AI's Azumarill Protects or digs; low but player-driven

rules.notStageable: Looks impossible in singles. Every protect-affected stat-lowering path meets Protect earlier: ordinary moves at accuracycheck (JumpIfMoveAffectedByProtect, battle_script_commands.c:1044, :1109), Memento through its own protected branch (battle_scripts_1.s:2206), Intimidate passes STAT_CHANGE_NOT_PROTECT_AFFECTED, Curse is excluded by name in ChangeStatBuffs (battle_script_commands.c:6981-6986), and self-drops (Superpower, Overheat) need a hit that a protected target blocks. Metronome calls run the same scripts. No custom party changes this (it is script structure), so the Mechanic Lab cannot stage it either.

rules.comment: Spinda (Own Tempo) confuses Kadabra, Kadabra Role Plays Own Tempo and is cured at move end

rules.notStageable: Real sets can build it only with a 1/340 Metronome call in one exact turn: no set from 267 up has Taunt, so the AI's Clefable 389 must call Taunt with Metronome and leave the field in that same turn (Taunt lasts only into the next turn's choice: timer 2, battle_script_commands.c:9160, minus 1 at turn end, battle_util.c:1749). The player cannot force the exit: Roar/Whirlwind (priority -6) is itself blocked by the fresh Taunt, and a KO or residual faint cannot be timed to the Taunt turn. About 0.1% per seed. Mechanic Lab: give the AI's Pokemon (challenge 4 or later) Taunt and Counter, let it Taunt on turn 1 and score Counter on turn 2 (both copies: player's last move an attack, then a status move).
